$provenance.note: Workbook's sample data, not the owner's. Read with openpyxl data_only=True (cached values). Plan S13a, workbook-year part 1: the Year's month rows, the gate at asOf, totals and the starting balance.

$semantics.transcription: F11. Annual Budget shows 2025 (D6) but reads budgets, goals and the starting balance from the 2026 month tabs by month name (Hidden!J4 =Jan!$O$9, N4 =Jan!$D$21, J18 =Jan!D9). One engine reading one year (D10) can only reproduce that if January's typed values are re-dated from 2026-01 to 2025-01, and February's typed zeros to 2025-02, so they are. Only Hidden!O, Q and S (bills, debts, subscriptions Actual) use Annual's own year, through Annual Budget!C30:C41, so the ledger holds the Bills-log rows and no Transactions rows: those are dated 2025 and Annual never reads them.
$semantics.budgetHistory: D12. Jan's typed Budgeted and Goal cells are 'onward' rows at 2025-01. Feb..Dec type 0 in D22, J22, O22, T22, O10 and T10 and leave the rest blank; one 'onward' row at 2025-02 holding 0, for each category January gave more than 0, reads the same for every later month, as Workbook's sums read a blank as 0.
$semantics.gate: F10. Hidden!O4 =SUMIFS(the log, that month)+IF(month <= Annual Budget!$D$7, Bills!$D$32, ""): a month's planned amounts count only up to the typed Current Month, 2025-05. E29 and Q29 (5 x 800, 5 x 17.99) and E34 (May, 800) prove the gate includes the month of asOf; E35 and Hidden!O15 (June, December: 0) prove later months leave the plan out. Hidden!Q5 is February's Credit Card 1 plan, 50.
$semantics.totals: D29, J29, P29, V29 =SUM(x30:x42), twelve months of a list's budgets: January's alone, February's typed 0 stopping the carry. P10 =D30+J30+P30+V30 and Q14 =E34+K34+Q34+W34 are one month's expense budget and Actual. J9 and V9 are the income and savings goal totals; they sum only seven months in Workbook (D7), which the sample cannot show, its later goals being 0.
$semantics.startingBalance: Annual Budget!D18 =D44, the start month's typed balance (Jan!D9, re-dated per F11).
$semantics.signs: D3: logged payments are positive in Bills!Q and negated in the ledger.
$semantics.left out: Plan section 5.4. Annual Budget!K29, K30, H27, Q10 and Hidden!Q4 add Credit Card 1's $200 to its $50 plan, where D5 replaces the plan. Q11 is February 2026 spending under a 2025 heading, and K9, W9, W30 read 2026 Actuals that F11's ledger holds none of. P9, Q9, N6, D11, D15, D20 are Workbook's range and blank-cell mistakes (D7). D44:D55 beyond D44 repeat the typed 1000.
$semantics.merchants: The engine takes no merchant text; Bills!R (Notes) is not transcribed. Ids are synthetic.
